ValidationRule.description: Only the assigned reviewer, or someone with Manage Scholarships, changes a review's scores, status or comments.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(ISNEW()), OR(ISCHANGED(Score__c), ISCHANGED(Scores__c), ISCHANGED(Status__c), ISCHANGED(Comments__c), ISCHANGED(Recusal_Reason__c)), Reviewer__c <> $User.Id, NOT($Permission.Scholarships_Manage))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only the reviewer, or a holder of Manage Scholarships, can change a review.
